auth_methods.quote: Sentry supports OAuth2 with the authorization code grant type.

access.quote: You can create authentication tokens within Sentry by creating an internal integration. This is also available for self-hosted Sentry.

api_surface.breadth.quote: You can use the APIs to manage account-level resources, like organizations and teams, as well as manage and export data.

mcp.exists.quote: The base MCP server address is: https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp

buildability.main_blocker.quote: Our public endpoints are generally stable, but beta endpoints are subject to change.

buildability.verdict.quote: Authentication tokens are passed using an auth header, and are used to authenticate as a user or organization account with the API.
